portrait.alt: Call me Charvin if you like.

sections.text: I am a reader, a thinker, an optimist, and a dedicated pathfinder.

sections.heading: My current focus (Updated in Nov. 2026)
sections.text: I study control theory and dynamical systems, with interests in estimation, observability, Kalman filtering, and cooperative robotics. I’m also interested in information-theoretic sensing and optimization, and in AI agents for engineering and formal verification.
